newsitem.title: FRANCE: PSA seeks to group China production in Wuhan.
newsitem.headline: PSA seeks to group China production in Wuhan.

text.p: PSA Peugeot Citroen Chairman Jacques Calvet said on Thursday the company aimed to group its production in China at the Citroen plant in Wuhan.
He told a news conference Chinese authorities consider the Citroen plant a key auto project "which has never been the case with our plant in Canton (Guangzhou)".
"What we want to do is rationalise our production and bring it together in the modern plant" of Wuhan, he said. Calvet said both Peugeot and Citroen cars would be produced at the plant.

The company said in December it was considering concentrating its production in China at the Wuhan plant after experiencing difficulties in Guangzhou due both to monetary tightening in China and disagreements with its Chinese partner over the models in production -- Peugeot 505 and 504 cars.
Calvet said discussions with Chinese authorities on grouping production in Wuhan were under way but would take time.
Guangzhou Peugeot Automobile Co, which is 30 percent owned by Peugeot, has produced only 100,000 cars since it went into production in 1986.
Peugeot Managing Director Yves Barbe said production would continue in Guangzhou for a time.
He said the Wuhan plant turned out 20,000-25,000 Citroen ZX cars last year and the objective this year is to produce 35,000. The plant has capacity to produce 150,000 cars.
